translation.voice_policy: Retain Kalaignar's parliamentary voice and language in English: argumentative sequence, long rhetorical movement, repetitions for emphasis, direct address, rhetorical questions, irony, wordplay, humour, register shifts and contextual stage markers are preserved rather than polished into generic modern English; source claims are not silently corrected.
